name: Auroral Armaments
body:
Sometimes destruction requires more than just stellar power.

Prerequisite(s): Zodiac with the aurora orbit, BAB +4

Benefit(s): While you are wielding the weapon form of a constellation you may take a swift action to add your aurora torch damage to a single attack with that constellation.
